_comment: Anonymous public surface for CI / post-deploy smoke. Environment-independent envelope shapes only — never assert live scores or prices (vendor/time dependent). Auth-gated endpoints live in auth-gated.json. Since SEC-1 (2026-10-26) GET /api/scan, GET /api/scan/all and GET /api/scan/{symbol}/history are signed-in reads, because their dealer levels derive from the licensed options feed: this sweep asserts their signed-out 403 auth_required refusal, and their signed-in envelopes are in auth-gated.json. Owner gate (2026-10-26, DESIGN.md Amendments): the scan reads and every other read computed from the licensed options feed (the ticker bundle and stream, market-data, signals, strike-profile, contract, candidates, and the recommendation post, export and status) answer the OWNER_EMAILS accounts alone; this sweep asserts their signed-out 403 auth_required refusal.

endpoints._note: Owner gate (2026-10-26): owner only (licence-derived data), so a cookieless read is the 403 auth_required refusal before the handler, the path or the query is read (the runner checks types, not the code). Holds on a paused or a live backend alike. The owner's view is asserted with an owner session in owner-gated.json and the feature specs marked _owner_gate.
